An '''unpopular Bartyn''' was the [[Administrator (ORO)|administrator]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] c. [[229 BBY/Legends|229 BBY]]. This person built a secret tunnel from the [[Bartyn mansion]] to the mines of the family.
